creative_direction: Create an old stone stair leading to a plain lichen-covered gateway. Render the nearest step edges and lichen patches carefully, then soften the far stones. Warm sunlight crosses the stair, while pale mist keeps the upper background uncluttered. Use detailed environmental watercolor. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
